caption:
Are you someone people feel lighter around?

The Prophet ﷺ taught us to gladden people, not scare them away, and to make things easy, not difficult. A simple test for how we treat the people around us.

Sunan Abi Dawud 4835 · Grade: Sahih

Send this to the person who always makes your day easier

#makeiteasy #goodcharacter #prophetsunnah #hadithreels
